profile.headline: AI Native Software Engineer Analyst at Accenture | Computer Science & Business Data Analytics
profile.summary:
Throughout my career, I have always been very passionate about bridging the gap between technology and people - turning complex and abstract ideas into practical solutions that make an impact. I am currently studying Business Data Analytics and Computer Science with an emphasis on Software Engineering at Arizona State University. 

What really draws me to tech consulting is the variety - every challenge is different, every client has a different story, and there is always something new to learn. I have had the chance to work on projects involving data, team coordination, and client support. Through my experiences with internships and school involvement, I have learned the value of clear communication, working across teams, and staying flexible. 

I am excited about future opportunities where I can grow through continuous learning, meaningful connections, and turning ideas into solutions that matter.

positions.title: Event Planner
positions.description: I work with a team to design and execute about 5 events a semester with over 50 people in attendance in order to develop community engagement.

positions.title: Technology Summer Analyst
positions.description: As a Tech Summer Analyst at Accenture, I worked with a social media company to support data pipeline compliance and reporting initiatives. I edited and maintained Apache Airflow pipelines to meet internal data policies, created visuals to demonstrate cost savings, and collaborated with client teams to resolve tickets and ensure a smooth workflow execution.
positions.insights: Skills: Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · Client Communication

positions.title: Peer Advisor
positions.description: During new student orientation season, I informed new students about the resources W.P. Carey School of Business has to offer. Additionally, I assisted students in finalizing their schedule.

company.name: W. P. Carey School of Business – Arizona State University

positions.title: Project Management Intern
positions.description:
•	Assisting the project management team in planning and executing various projects, identifying opportunities for process and system improvements using existing metrics, analyzing data, and collaborating with cross-functional team
•	Supporting the project management team in the company-wide Agile Transformation by gathering data and devising strategies to integrate the Agile Framework with our existing systems
•	Enhancing consulting and project management skills by tackling complex business challenges, demonstrating excellent analytical abilities, and utilizing technology-driven business intelligence tools

projects.title: Thesis: Business Design Lab
projects.description: For this project, I have been working in cohorts to hypothesize, test, and present validation for new business designs for valley-based entrepreneurs utilizing the Scrum methodology to produce key deliverables. I have been working with Opingo, a new social media, to help develop a marketing plan, and Photovoctaics, a recycling solar panel company, to help develop a business plan.
